notable_absence.finding: No edition badges, support-plan gating, or server-version-string citations anywhere on this page - both known recurring anomalies are absent here. The Allowed IP feature (75-entry cap, temporary/permanent expiration) is presented as universally available regardless of plan or edition.

cross_component_finding: This page's Prerequisites line cites exactly three of the registry's eight roles - Organization Owner (org-scope) plus Project Owner and Cluster Manager (project-scope) - as a disjunctive gate, in the same flattened style round 6 found on SQL++ statement pages. All three names match the corrected catalog exactly (no naming drift, no anomaly), which is itself informative: this is a plain, uncomplicated confirmation of the existing 3-org/5-project split rather than a new wrinkle.
cross_product_finding: None - this page has no server/ RBAC or data-plane privilege content; the Allowed IP list is a network-layer control, gated purely by capella-role:*, orthogonal to cluster-access-credential-type and the privilege:capella-* catalog covered by cluster-rbac.md.
